# Skipper (AyeAyeSkipper)

> Skipper is management software for marinas and yacht clubs. It holds your spaces, boats, contracts, billing and messages in one system, with a live map of your property and an AI assistant that does the day-to-day work. One switch turns the AI off for the whole marina.

Website: https://ayeayeskipper.com

## What it covers
- Slips, moorings, yard and storage on one map drawn to scale from satellite
- Contracts and e-sign, recurring billing and payments, deposits and receipts
- Fuel dock point of sale, work orders, parts and inventory, ship store
- Messaging (office, dock, fuel, service channels), wait list, boater app
- Transient bookings with the Hot Slip program (permanent tenants lend their slip while away)
- Fleet view for several marinas on one account
- Yacht clubs: priced by members, moorings-only clubs see only moorings

## Pricing (published, per month)
One price by size, every module in every plan, no setup or onboarding fee. $99 (up to 20 slips and moorings), $199, $299, $499, $799 (over 250 or several marinas). Yacht clubs use the same prices by member count. No Skipper fee on transient bookings; card processors charge their normal card fees.

## Moving over
Send your boat and owner lists, your layout and your contracts. Skipper draws every space, loads your records and hands you a live map.

## Integrations
Stripe, Clover and text messaging are live. Other tools are built when a marina asks.
